description.value: Britannia Community Centre is a sprawling 17-acre campus in East Vancouver, managed through a partnership of city agencies and celebrating its 50th year in 2026. The complex encompasses a pool, ice rink, fitness centre, multiple gyms and courts, community gardens, public art installations, a library, and an art gallery, making it one of Vancouver's most comprehensive neighbourhood hubs. Touring cyclists passing through East Vancouver will find a genuinely community-rooted destination with a wide range of recreational and cultural offerings in a single campus.
